crossRefs.note: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.
Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on…

You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.

God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.

translations.web: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.
translations.bsb: And Noah waited seven more days and sent out the dove again, but this time she did not return to him.
translations.kjv: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.
translations.asv: And he stayed yet other seven days, and sent forth the dove; and she returned not again unto him any more.
